reasons.claim: The father and the group of shaykhs are co-transmitters at the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله) وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي عَنْ

reasons.claim: The chain runs by «عن» through six names to the Imam, as both readers write.
reasons.quote: عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) قَالَ

reasons.claim: Ibn Bazi' relates that the Imam was asked while he listened; the Imam who answers is the last link and the unnamed asker is not written.
reasons.quote: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ

reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni relates by his isnad, kept as a back reference, ending at the speaker named after it.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ

reasons.claim: The Imam speaks with no transmitter before him, so he is the single link under the compiler.
The report is the saying alone, with no transmitter or speaker named.
The passive «روي» names no transmitter and no source, so there is no isnad.
Aban and an unnamed other are co-transmitters between Ibn Abi Umayr and the Imam.
reasons.quote: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The persons in the Imam's story are not links.
The passive «روي» names no transmitter and no source, so there is no isnad.
Al-Sakuni relates by his isnad, kept as a back reference; the Prophet ends the chain and is not a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The father and the group of shaykhs are co-transmitters at the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي رَحِمَهُمُ اللَّهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ

reasons.claim: The chain ends at the Imam who tells the story; Amir al-Mu'minin is inside his words.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) قَالَ مَرَّ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
